meta.name: Dual-Gender Nouns
meta.description: German nouns whose meaning changes with the article. These tricky words are a common source of errors even for advanced learners.

genders.english: woman/female person (regional and dated, usually derogatory)
piece/item or concrete component (e.g. ein Ersatzteil)
point/tip of a weapon or tool (archaic/technical)

reviewHistory.recommendation: Remove the masculine sense from the spelling `Alter` (or model the nominalised adjective separately as headword `Alte`: `der Alte`, plural `Alten`); for `das Alter` store plural `—` and `singularOnly=true`
